messages:
samir: Hey @jess — we just got a support ticket from a customer about generated invoices losing line items after last night's rollout. They say a tiny template tweak (one whitespace) now breaks output.
jess: attaching customer repro and request-id r-12345. Customer says it used to work. No API errors, no latency spikes.
samir: paste of minimal repro from customer: 
```
Prompt (worked before):
Invoice:
Item: Subscription
Amount: $10.00

Prompt (now breaks):
Invoice:
Item: Subscription
Amount $10.00
```
Customer says removing the colon after "Amount" causes the renderer to strip the currency line entirely.
support-bot: New ticket INC-9876 created by samir.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout completed: release=2026-03-16-3 commit=ab12cd kernel-change=quant-select
claire: assigning to eng. @rohit can you take a quick look — seems tied to rollout that touched quantized routing/variant selection? :eyes:
rohit: on it. can you paste the full request payload and headers (model, variant, any routing hints)?
samir: payload we received: {"model":"gptx-3.1","model_variant":"gptx-3.1-q8","prompt":"Invoice:\nItem: Service\nAmount $10.00"} plus standard auth header. Customer is using our hosted API.
jess: customer confirms they hit no 4xx/5xx, just the text output is wrong. They tried multiple runs, deterministic regression after rollout.
claire: quick theory: routing now prefers q8 quantized variant for some requests; tokenization boundaries can change across quantized kernels leading to tiny prompt deltas producing different completions. can we repro locally?
rohit: running quick curl test.
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"gptx-3.1-q8","prompt":"Invoice:\nItem: Service\nAmount $10.00"}'
```
rohit: confirmed — with gptx-3.1-q8 the output often omits the "$10.00" token when the prompt lacks the colon. with gptx-3.1 (non-q8) it preserves the currency text.
samir: wow. so small punctuation causes different tokenization and downstream behavior. any quick mitigations for the customer?
rohit: two immediate options: 1) rollback the canary routing so this customer is served by non-q8; 2) add a per-customer routing override to force non-q8 until we fix compatibility. also add a short-term prompt-normalization on the client side: ensure 'Amount:' remains with colon.
claire: prefer routing override to be safest. samir, can we offer that and communicate it's temporary?
samir: told customer we'll apply routing override and give repro steps to normalize their template as a mitigation. they accepted workaround.
deploy-bot: Applied routing override: route-555 -> target=gptx-3.1 for customer_acme at 2026-03-17T09:12Z.
jess: Customer confirmed invoices restored after override. They verified multiple samples. :white_check_mark:
rohit: creating ENG ticket ENG-5890 to add tests: include a small corpus of minimal prompt deltas (colon vs no-colon, whitespace changes) across model variants and quantization flavors. Also will investigate tokenization mapping changes after quant kernel selection.
claire: please add postmortem notes if rollout changes kernel selection heuristics. we should have an automated canary check that runs a few sensitive templates from support samples.
samir: I'll keep the support incident open until ENG marks the fix. thanks everyone for the fast triage :heart:
jess: filing follow-up with customer success to update the KB: "Invoice generator: known prompt sensitivity with q8 variant" and include normalization snippet.
rohit: note for engineers: reproducible minimal update attached to ENG ticket. example test case: "Amount $10.00" vs "Amount: $10.00" across variants.
claire: great — targeting root-cause analysis and adding regression tests. closing internal support thread after ENG confirms.
